nodes.v: Board-certified prosthodontist — three years of specialist training beyond dental school.
A weekend implant course, or a referral out.
Surgery and final teeth planned and placed by the same specialist.
Handed between a surgeon, a dentist and an outside lab.
The final smile is designed first — implants are placed to serve it.
Implants placed first, restoration figured out afterwards.
Complex and failed cases accepted — including work other practices decline.
IV sedation certified, with hospital privileges at Inova Fairfax.
Local anaesthetic, or a referral for sedation.
